The '''SY-7''' was a model of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] produced by [[Tion Industries]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Tion SY-7 was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on [[September 1]], [[2015]] as one of the items in the Wild Space Explorer's Pack on the Cartel Market.
